call_points.text: Leisure strategy unchanged at 20% of the portfolio despite strong resort performance.
CIGNUS II Powai on track for substantial completion by FY27 end; step-change in growth from FY2028.
Taj Delhi airport: minimum 70 rooms to launch in Q4FY27, balance within Q1FY28.
South Goa construction hoped to start by end of this quarter; design and contracting ready.
Udaipur expansion awaits local authority and army cantonment approvals; clarity expected over next quarter or two.
Commercial portfolio 91% committed after a 66,000 sq ft LOI at Bangalore.
Yearly rentals give eligibility for ₹2,000 Cr LRD; lease rentals cover the entire interest cost.
Management declined to guide on Q2 occupancy, citing day-to-day volatility from the West Asia conflict.
Deloitte lease at Westin Hyderabad Hitec renewed for one more year; terms revisited by end of fiscal.
Resort occupancy at about 43% for FY26, expected to trend towards 60% as the assets mature.
April was stronger than expected and May is strong, helped by a weak base; June looks steady.
Udaipur resort acquired for ₹171 Cr for 144 keys on 8.2 acres; timelines, capex and brand not yet decided.
CIGNUS II Powai on track for substantial completion by FY27 end, though West Asia crisis has pressured labour availability.
City hotel margins are at a stable point where flow-through equals margin; leisure margins expected to reach at least mid-40s.
Enabling approval for debt raise of up to ₹1,000 Cr taken, with no immediate plan to draw it.
DIAL project-level minority stake sale is a one-time partnership experiment, not a capital decision, per the MD.
CFO declined to give margin or stabilisation guidance for the Ritz-Carlton Hyderabad, citing back-ended capex.

operating_notes.text: March 2026 CRE rental exit run rate was ₹280 million a month, with portfolio committed at about 88% and Powai occupancy at 90%.
About 9,000 foreign-tourist room nights were lost in March 2026 alone, with geopolitical tensions causing a 10-12% disruption to business.
The CRE portfolio has 2.4 million sq ft of leasable area with potential to generate ₹3-4 billion of annual cash flows at stabilisation.
Commercial real estate was 91% committed at June 2026, with a June rental run rate of INR290 million per month.
Resort occupancy was about 51% in Q1FY27 against a stabilised 60-65% level.
Mumbai Metropolitan Region was close to 43% of hospitality revenue in Q1FY27.
